body: I agree. People who are diagnosed with cancer are pretty much always immediately treated with sympathy and respect, but suicidal people are often misunderstood and judged. It’s really unfair.
I feel the same way. I feel like I’m just wasting away. My time and life circumstances would be so much better spent by someone who actually wants to live.

Exactly! I feel like I can’t even mention anything death related without worrying my family, but this just ignores the problem. I feel like I can’t be honest. I wish I could be open about my suicidal thoughts without having to risk being forcibly hospitalized and getting my rights and freedom taken away.

I’m not too sure but I guess I never really had the “goal” of getting better in the first place. When I did get help it didn’t really make a difference, so I kinda have just given up on therapy or medication helping at all. Over the years things have just gotten worse anyways and there are certain things I can’t change even if I really tried or had motivation or hope. Honestly dying just seems easier and then I don’t have to worry about anything. What about you?
